# Parking Lot Issue Comment Templates

Use these templates when commenting on [Issue #11 (Parking Lot)](https://github.com/devtrainNIC/Initial-repo/issues/11).

## Quick Question Template
Copy and paste this template for quick questions:

```markdown
### 🅿️ [Question Category: Git/GitHub/Activity/Technical/Best Practices]

**Question:** [Your question here]

**Context:** [What you were trying to do]

**Additional Info:** [Any error messages, screenshots, or other details]

---
📚 **Resources I've checked:** [List any docs/guides you've already looked at]
🆘 **Urgency:** [Low/Medium/High - is this blocking your progress?]
```

## Help with Activity Template
For activity-specific help:

```markdown
### 🚀 Activity Help: [Activity Name]

**Activity:** [e.g., "Activity 1: Your First Caption"]
**Current Status:** 
- [x] Completed step 1
- [x] Completed step 2  
- [ ] Stuck on step 3

**Specific Issue:** [What exactly you're stuck on]

**What I've Tried:** [Any solutions you've attempted]

---
🔗 **Related:** [Link to any relevant files, pull requests, or other issues]
```

## Quick Examples

### Git Command Question
```markdown
### 🅿️ Git Workflow Question

**Question:** How do I create a new branch and switch to it?

**Context:** I want to start working on Activity 1 but want to make sure I'm on a separate branch.

**Additional Info:** I'm currently on the main branch.

---
📚 **Resources I've checked:** README
🆘 **Urgency:** Low
```

### Technical Issue
```markdown
### 🅿️ Technical Issue

**Question:** Getting "Permission denied" error when trying to push

**Context:** Trying to push my first commit for Activity 1

**Additional Info:** 
```
git push origin add-caption-myname
remote: Permission to devtrainNIC/Initial-repo.git denied to myusername.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/devtrainNIC/Initial-repo.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```

---
📚 **Resources I've checked:** GitHub docs on authentication
🆘 **Urgency:** High - blocking my progress
```

---

💡 **Tips for better questions:**
- Use code blocks (\`\`\`) for commands and error messages
- Include screenshots when helpful (just drag and drop!)
- Be specific about what you expected vs. what happened
- Tag people with @ if you need their attention (e.g., @Parul-mahajan)
